The historical ledger contains NO observable witness-authoring action: historical C2 authored its K3 attestation inside its compile-result return node as one of several deliverables, so the historical observation surface cannot expose the very action H6 would need to match.
Forcing PASS would require hiding C2''s witness-authoring propose as tau; that would silence the governed observable of exactly the capability Experiment 4C tests, so it is declined.

Per protocol: the historical-C2 abstraction cannot be constructed with a comparable witness-authoring observation without inventing missing events; H6 is therefore INDETERMINATE (insufficient comparable historical observation surface), which does not affect the primary result.
